context.hint: Apply one failed-sign-in budget per account across supported identifiers.
context.surface: A user provider resolves login identifiers, and a regulator stores authentication attempt counters.
assumptions: The provider supplies a stable identifier for accounts recognized through supported aliases.

review.invariant: Lockout queries and failure updates use the same account identifier returned by the provider.
review.verification: Use fixture accounts with supported aliases. Verify shared accounting for one account and separate accounting for a second account.

source_observation.summary: A local test found that identifiers resolving to the same account were tracked separately by the original regulator.
